newsitem.title: USA: American Freightways to up rates 5.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: American Freightways to up rates 5.9 pct.

text.p: American Freightways Corp said on Monday its operating subsidiary, American Freightways Inc, would institute a 5.9 percent general rate increase effective January 1.
The company said the increase applied to its interstate and intrastate, except Arkansas intrastate, common carrier freight rates published in its 5000 series class tariff.
Additional adjustments would be made in certain longer-haul and over-balanced lanes, the company said. Minimum charge floors would increase by $2.50, it said.
The company said about 45 percent of its shipments were rated under the series 5000 and 505 tariffs, and the increases and lane adjustments should boost total company revenues by about 2.9 percent.
Arkansas intrastate rates published in the company's 505 series tariff would increase 15 percent, the company said.
These rates had not been adjusted since January 1, 1995 and were on average 53 percent lower than comparable interstate rates, the company said.
